notes.notes:
Hi everyone! I am KurokumaSoft, a game developer.

notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
This is a small update. I have fixed the following minor issues.

notes.title: Demo Update v0.5.0
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!
I am KurokumaSoft, a game developer.

Today I updated the demo to v0.5.0. This time I have made some changes and improvements.

Changes in v0.5.0
[olist]
Added a menu to take a good look at Mio.
You can access it from the camera icon on the title screen.
Changed the damage multiplier when attacking an enemy's weak point from 2x to 3x.
Increased the number of actions that can be modified in the control mapping.
Other minor improvements and bug fixes.
[/olist]

The development of this game is going well and is currently about 80% complete. Please continue to support me as I work hard to develop this game with the goal of releasing it in July of this year!

I will post again with any new announcements.
See you soon!

notes.title: Demo Update v0.4.0
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!
I am KurokumaSoft, a game developer.

Today I updated the demo to v0.4.0. One important and pleasant change was made in this update.

Changes in v0.4.0:
Reloading of water guns has been removed. From now on, you can shoot the water guns as long as you like without reloading!
Also, some key bindings have been changed along with this change.

After careful consideration, I have decided that reloading is not necessary for this game. I hope you feel refreshed after shooting as many water guns as you like!

I will post again with any new announcements.
See you soon!

notes.title: Demo update v0.3.0
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!
I'm KurokumaSoft, a game developer.

As the first news of the year, I am pleased to announce that I have updated my demo to v0.3.0.
This update includes various improvements and bug fixes.

Changes in v0.3.0

HP of nearby enemies is now displayed.
The number of enemies remaining is now displayed when an enemy wave starts.
Special effects now appear when attacking an enemy's weak point.
All enemies now emit an effect when defeated. Not only does this make the screen more lively, but it also makes it easier to know that you have defeated that enemy.
Weapons whose bullets land immediately were adjusted to make them more suitable for close quarters combat. Power attenuation by distance has been added to this type of weapon.
Changed the font to a rounded one.
Fixed a problem where enemies were making unnecessary movements.
Fixed a problem in which some attack actions were not canceled when an enemy was knocked down.


The development of this game is going well. It is cold and hard to work in Japan right now, but I am working for a summer release and I hope you are looking forward to it.

I will post any new announcements. See you soon!

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I am KurokumaSoft, the developer of the game.

I am happy to announce that I have updated the demo version of the game. The updates are as follows:

[olist]
I have added level 2 of the story mode to the demo version. This will increase the volume of the demo and increase the total play time to about 15 minutes.
Lots of improvements and bug fixes.
[/olist]

Even if you have already played the demo, I would be happy if you could play level 2.

By the way, the development of this title is progressing well. The release is still some way off, but I hope you are looking forward to it.

I will post again if there is something new. See you soon!

notes.title: Demo version is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm KurokumaSoft, a game developer.
Today I have released a demo version of my new FPS "Mio and the Hot Summer".

In this demo, you can try out the first level of the story mode.
Level 1 is a tutorial, so you won't see a lot of enemies, but it should be enough to get you a feel for the game. Please give it a try!

The full version will be released in July 2024.
If you are interested in this game, please add it to your wish list and follow me! I still have a lot of work to do before it is completed, but I am doing my best to develop it and I hope you can look forward to it.

See you soon!
